label: Article 4
title: The Morality of Human Acts
path: Section One: Man's Vocation Life in the Spirit
Chapter One: The Dignity of the Human Person

r: Freedom makes man a moral subject. When he acts deliberately, man is, so to speak, the father of his acts. Human acts, that is, acts that are freely chosen in consequence of a judgment of conscience, can be morally evaluated. They are either good or evil.
